title: ID0399192-DC/Si-D/AT - [MnzQiz] Charger offline
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
We wanted to put this station into operation remotely yesterday. However, nothing happened after the customer switching on the station. After pressing FC12, the heating started to run, but everything else remained black. We then closed the door and waited. After a few hours, the charger suddenly went online in the SCB (no error flags), unfortunately the customer was no longer on site at the time. It was only a few degrees above 0 yesterday but NO minus degrees. Now I wanted to configure the charger today and see that it is offline again in the SCB?!? Please send me a work order to see what is wrong with this charger.
Root cause: NA
Solution: No response case closer
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: No
Warranty Status:
Active
